If no safe word has been selected, no action is authorized.","definition":"Authorization exists only when the user has first selected a safe word and then provides that exact safe word as approval for the displayed plan. Classification is semantic, not keyword-only.","action_examples":[{"action_id":"create_file","action":"Create a new file or document.","classification":"action","evaluation":"Creates new persistent action."},{"action_id":"delete_file","action":"Delete a file or document.","classification":"action","evaluation":"Removes data, so it is a deletion action."},{"action_id":"rename_or_move_file","action":"Rename or move a file.","classification":"action","evaluation":"Mutates the artifact's path or identity metadata, so it is a mutation action."},{"action_id":"copy_file","action":"Copy a file or document.","classification":"action","evaluation":"Creates a new data instance, so it is a creation communication data, so it is a creation action."},{"action_id":"create_calendar_event","action":"Create a calendar event or appointment.","classification":"action","evaluation":"Creates persistent scheduling data, so it is a creation action."},{"action_id":"modify_calendar_event","action":"Change a calendar event or appointment.","classification":"action","evaluation":"Mutates persistent scheduling data, so it is a mutation action."},{"action_id":"commit_source_control_change","action":"Create a source-control commit.","classification":"action","evaluation":"Creates a persistent repository record and changes repository history, so it is a creation/mutation action."},{"action_id":"push_source_control_change","action":"Push commits or refs to a remote repository.","classification":"action","evaluation":"Mutates remote repository state, so it is a mutation action."},{"action_id":"merge_pull_request","action":"Merge a pull request or actions."},{"action_id":"run_test_or_build","action":"Run a test suite, build, lint, benchmark, or validation job.","classification":"action","evaluation":"It performs computation, may create logs or and shares the pattern of checking/reading."},{"action_id":"inspect_artifact","action":"Inspect an artifact, screenshot, image, document, repository state, or work/resources."},{"action_id":"check_status_or_poll","action":"Check status, poll a workflow, refresh state, or repeatedly re-query a source.","classification":"action","evaluation":"Checking is
